name: Scanner
summary: The Scanner walks a directory tree from a given root, reads each file within bounded size limits, classifies it against curated credential / private-key / generated-file heuristics, and returns a structured ScanResult. Risk classification is split across filename, path-segment, file-extension, and content regex signal sets defined as module-level constants in risk.ts.
keyPoints: scan(root, options) is the public entry point; it invokes walk() to recurse directories and readFile() per file, propagating an IgnoreStack so nested ignores compose. readFile() gates reads by isBinary() and the size thresholds DEFAULT_MAX_READ_BYTES (4 MiB) and DETECTION_WINDOW (64 KiB) used for credential content inspection.

classifyRisk(RiskInput) fuses four orthogonal signal families: filename sets (PRIVATE_KEY_FILENAMES, CREDENTIAL_FILENAMES), path-segment / extension patterns (GENERATED_PATH_SEGMENTS, ENV_TEMPLATE_SUFFIXES, PRIVATE_KEY_EXTENSIONS), content regexes (PRIVATE_KEY_CONTENT, CREDENTIAL_CONTENT, GENERIC_SECRET), and banner detectors (GENERATED_CONTENT, GENERATED_FILENAME). Live-secret false positives are dampened by PLACEHOLDER_WORDS via looksLikeLiveSecret() and by isCertificateOnly().

Generated and lockfile artefacts are explicitly enumerated: GENERATED_PATH_SEGMENTS / GENERATED_FILENAME / GENERATED_CONTENT cover dist, build outputs, .min.js, sourcemaps, protobuf stubs, and 'DO NOT EDIT' banners; LOCKFILES collects 16 package-manager lock names (npm, yarn, pnpm, bun, go.sum, cargo.lock, poetry.lock, uv.lock, etc.) for separate handling.

entryPoints.name: scan
entryPoints.note: Public async entry point; traverses root, returns ScanResult with file records and risk classifications.

entryPoints.name: walk
entryPoints.note: Recursive directory walker carrying an IgnoreStack so ignore patterns inherit into subtrees.

entryPoints.name: readFile
entryPoints.note: Per-file reader; applies isBinary() and size limits, then calls classifyRisk() to attach Risk[] to the FileRecord.

entryPoints.name: classifyRisk
entryPoints.note: Central risk classifier combining filename, path, extension, and content signals into Risk[] output.

entryPoints.name: hasCredentialContent
entryPoints.note: Public helper that runs CREDENTIAL_CONTENT / GENERIC_SECRET regexes against file text.
